book.title: Nhalo ghwa Maha handa paghutyekitwe na Yohane Yohane

content: Yesu na alongo bhake
Mbole ya milando ayi, Yesu kakighenda mu hijiji nhangangaiko hya ku Galilaya, kakilema kughenda kukitami kya Yudea kiyaha hilongohi bha Akaayahudi bhakipala kunkoma.
Peniapo kikubhukubhu kya Akaayahudi kiikemitwe kikubhukubhu kya hibanda, kikiheghelela,
Hino, alongo bhake Yesu bhakinng'ombela, “Ghubhuke apa, ghughende ku Yudea ili ahundwa bhako bhakabhone mihabho yighuyitenda.
Mundu ywakapala kumanyikwa na bhandu kangutenda ng'obhe milando yake kwa kihiho. Handa kiyaha ghungutenda milando ayi, hino, ghulibhonehe kwa bhoha ili bhandu bhakumanye!”
Hata alongo bhake mwene bhakinhyubhalila ng'obhe.
Yesu kakiaghombela bhombe, kukita “Nndaluko ghwa nenga kughenda akwo ghukali kuhika. Peni kwa mwenga kila nndaluko ghungunoghwa.
Bhandu bha nnima bhanguhotola ng'obhe kubhakalalila mwenga, peni bhangungalalila nenga kiyaha nunguaghombela kukita, mandendelo ghabhe ghoha ghabhegha mahakataho.
Mwenga nng'ende ku kikubhukubhu, peni nenga ndaaghenda ng'obhe ku kikubhukubhu aki, kiyaha nndaluko ghwangu ghunahika ng'obhe.”
Yesu pakayomolite kulongela agho, kakihighala akwo ku nnima ghwa Galilaya.
Yesu kanguhunda pekupeku ku Nyumba ya Chaapanga
Alongo bhake paabhukite kughenda ku kikubhukubhu, na mbole Yesu kakighenda bhubho kwa kihiho.
Akwo ku kikubhukubhu hilongohi bha Akaayahudi bhakibhegha bhangumpalaha na kuakonya bhandu. “Kabhegha kwoki aywo Yesu?”
Kukibhegha na mbwepwe ndangalo yakya Yesu mu lumati lwa bhandu paalongela. Amoo bhandu bhakilongela “Mundu aywo ywa maha,” Na bhangi bhakilongela. “Akakaa! Ywombe kanguapotoha bhandu.”
Peni kahone mundu ywohele ywakayighite kulongela mihalo ya Yesu pakindandabhanji, kiyaha bhakiayoghopa hilongohi bha Akaayahudi.
Yesu kanguhunda ku kikubhukubhu
Payihikite pakati ya kikubhukubhu, Yesu kakighenda ku Nyumba ya Chapanga na kuahunda bhandu.
Ayahudi bhakikangahwa na mahundo ghake na bhakilongela, “Mundu ayu kahotola bhuli kumanya milando ayi kyangali kuhundwa?”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Mahundo ghanuahunda chepa gha numwene, ngati ghanguhuma kwa ywombe ywakanaghihite.
Mundu ywohele ywakapala kutenda ghakaghapala Chapanga, katamanya kukita mahundo ghangu ghanguhuma kwa Chapanga, ebu nungulongela gha nenga numwene.

Mundu ywakalongela malagho ghake mwene, kangupalaha kutikilwa mwene, kangutenda habhu kwa kupalaha ukulu ghwake. Peni yula ywakapalaha ukulu ghwa yula ywakannaghihite ndo ywa hoto, hangi kahone uhwangi nkati mwaki.
Bhuli, Musa kakiapegha ng'obhe Malaghilo? Peni kahone hata mundu yumu mu mwenga ywakaghayitikila malaghilo. Kiyaha niki, mungupala kungoma?”
Lula lumati lwa bhandu lukinnyanga, “Ghwenga ghubhegha na lindilo! Ndo ghani ywakapala kughukoma?”
Yesu kakiayanga, “Nikighutenda nhabho ghumu na mabhoha mukibhughanikwa.
Peni kiyaha Musa kakiakwilikiha kudumula unyagho, aki kitohe kikihuma ng'obhe kwa Musa, ngati kwa ahukulu bhenu, peni mwenga munguadumula unyagho bhana bhenu hata linjubha lya kupumulila.
Handa bhana munguadumula unyagho linjubha lya kupumulila ili kuyitikila malaghilo gha Musa, bhuli, mungungalalila kya kunnamiha mundu mmili ghwake linjubha lya kupumulila?
Nneke kutosa milando ya bhandu kyabhula muyibhonekana ghweka, maha ntose muyinoghwa.”
Ayu ndo Kilisito Nkombohi?
Amoo bhandu bha ku Yelusalemu bhakilongela, “Bhuli ayu chepa yula ywakapalahitwe na hilongohi bhetu ili bhankome?
Nnole, hinu kanguyobhela pakindandabhanji na kahone kilongohi ywakanng'ombela hata lilagho, pangi hilongohi bhamanya kala uhoto kukita ayu ndo Kilisito.
Pakahika Kilisito Nkombohi, kahone mundu ywakapala kumanya kwakahumite, peni twenga tungumanya kwakahuma mundu ayu.”

Ndo Yesu kakikweha lilobhe pakahunda ku Nyumba ya Chapanga pakalongela, “Bhuli, mwenga mungumanya nenga na mungumanya kunukuhuma? Nenga hika ng'obhe kwa utabhala ghwangu. Ywombe ywakanaghilite ndo ywa kuhyubhalika na mwenga mungummanya ng'obhe.
Peni nenga nungummanya, kiyaha huma kwa ywombe naywo ndo ywakanaghihite.”
Hino, bhandu bhakipalaha kunkamula, peni kahone mundu ywohele ywakayighite kunkamula kiyaha lisaa lyake likibhegha likali kuhika.
Na bhandu ayoloho bha mula mulumati bhakinnyubhalila na bhakilongela, “Bhuli, kilisto pakahika katatenda mihabho mikulu kyanalumu kupitingana yakayitenda ayu?”
Machonda bhangulaghilwa kunkamula Yesu
Afalisayu bhakiayihwa bhandu paapwepa yakya mihalo ya Yesu, ndo bhombe na hilongohi bha Mandundame bhakialaghila machonda bha Nyumba ya Chapanga bhakankamule Yesu.
Yesu kakilongela, “Nenga ndabhegha na mwenga kwa nndaluko ghwa mandina, mbole ndabhuya kwa ywombe ywakanaghilite.
Mambalaha peni mutamona ng'obhe, na kumbala kubhegha mwenga mahotola ng'obhe kuhika.”

Akaayahudi bhakikonyana bhene, “Ayu kangupala kughenda kwoki kweni twenga kutuhotola ng'obhe kuhika? Ebu kangupala kughenda ku hitami hya Akaayahudi kakaahunde Akaagiliki bhaapwilinganite, na kuahunda Akaagiliki?
Pakalongela malagho agha fwambulo yake niki, mambalaha peni mamona ng'obhe na akwo kumbala kughenda mwenga mahotola ng'obhe kuhika?”
Ngemba ya machi gha ubhumi
Linjubha lya uhiko lya kikubhukubhu, linjubha lya kindimba, Yesu kakiyima na kakilongela kya kukweha lilobhe, “Mundu ywohele yukabheghite na nyota kahike kwa nenga kanyweghe machi,
handa Malembo paghatyekitwe, ywohele ywakanyubhalila nenga, ‘Ngemba hya machi gha ubhumi ghaabhilibhita mu mwoyo ghwake.’ ”

Yesu kakilongela lilagho lila kwa mihalo ya Nhuki ywa Chapanga, ywene kwa bhala bhaanhyubhalilite bhangankingamite. Kiyaha Nhuki kakibhegha kakali kuhika kiyaha Yesu kakibhegha kakali kukwehwa mu Ukulu.
Bandu bhangughabhanika kwakya Yesu
Amoo bhandu mulumati lula paayihwite malagho agho, bhakilongela, “Kulyaghila mundu ayu ndo yula Mbuye yutunnindila!”
Bhandu bhangi bhakilongela, “Ayu ndo Kilisto Nkombohi!” Bhangi bhakilongela, “Bhuli, Kilisto Nkombohi katahumila ku Galilaya?
Bhuli, Malembo gha Chapanga ghatyekwa ng'obhe kukita Kilisto kaahika kuhuma mulukolo lwa Daudi na kubhelekwa ku Betilehemu, ku kitami kyakatamite Mutwa Daudi ng'obhe?”
Kya habhu bhandu bhakighabhanika kwakya malagho gha Yesu.
Amoo bhandu bhakipala kuyigha kunkamula, peni kahone mundu yumu ywakayighite kunkamula.
Hilongohi bha Akaayahudi bhangunhyubhalila ng'obhe Yesu
Mbole bhala machonda bhakibhuya kwa mandundame akulu na Afalisayo, na bhombe bhakiakonya, “Kyabhuli munankamula ng'obhe na kunnyegha?”
Bhala machonda bhakiayanga, “Kanabhonekana ng'obhe mundu munnima aghu kangulongela milando mikulu handa pakalongela mundu ayu!”
Afalisayo bhakiakonya bhala machonda, “Bhuli na mwenga, nkuluhwa?”
Bhuli, “Kabhegha kilongohi ywohele yumummanyite ebu Afalisayo bhaannyubhalila?
Peni lumati lwa bhandu lwangamanya Malaghilo gha Musa, bhombe bhakotolwa na Chapanga.”
Mbole yumu ywa Afalisayo kakibhegha Nikodemu, yula ywakanng'endelite Yesu linjubha limu pakilo. Kakiakonya ayake,
“Bhuli, Malaghilo ghetu ghangututegheka twenga kuntosa mundu ywohele pakali kunnyihwa na kumanya kyoki kyakatendite?”
Bhombe bhakinnyanga, “Bbhuli, na ghwenga bhubho ghuhuma ku Galilaya? Ghulihunde Malembo gha Chapanga na ghwenga ghwabhona kukita kahone mbuye ywakahumite ku Galilaya.”
Mbole bhakibhuka, kila mundu kakibhuya ukaya kwake.
